# Ark Malhotra (sqrt.fyi)

> Personal site of Ark Malhotra, computer science undergrad at NSUT chasing the joy of building software. Home to his blog, small web toys, and notes on what he is learning and reading.

- [Curriculum Vitae](https://cv.sqrt.fyi/): Home, projects, skills, and about for Ark Malhotra.

## Main Pages

- [Blog](https://sqrt.fyi/blog): Essays and writing by Ark Malhotra on programming, games, and whatever else he is thinking about.
- [Now](https://sqrt.fyi/now): What Ark Malhotra is currently learning, building, and reading.
- [Microblog](https://sqrt.fyi/microblog): Short thoughts, links, and updates fetched live from @sqrt-1.bsky.social on Bluesky.
- [Colophon](https://sqrt.fyi/colophon): How this site is built: the tools, fonts, and stack behind sqrt.fyi.
- [Questions](https://sqrt.fyi/questions): Open problems and puzzles Ark Malhotra is currently working through.
- [Contact](https://sqrt.fyi/contact): Ways to reach Ark Malhotra.

## Feeds & Indexes

- [Atom Feed](https://sqrt.fyi/feed.xml): Full feed of blog posts.
- [Sitemap](https://sqrt.fyi/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all pages.

## Markdown Source

- [Blog](https://sqrt.fyi/blog): Blog listing page.
- Every blog post's raw Markdown source is available by appending `.md` to its URL, e.g. https://sqrt.fyi/blog/nonslop.md
